note: from and to are hires' ids, nicknames or names. By default the pair may write to each other; oneWay: true allows only from to to; remove: true takes the pair away (with oneWay, only that direction). The answer is the pairs now; gm team answers the same list as contacts. A hire with no pair may write only to the GM.
file: registry.json keeps them as contacts: [{from, to}] (left out while empty), beside hires.

refusals-for-a-hire-writing.why: a hire writes to a hire only for an allowed pair; an unknown name and a name not allowed get the same refusal. The words name the rule: A hire may write to the GM, and to another hire only when the GM or the owner has allowed that pair.
